long_description: 明日方舟玩家个人信息展示：绑定森空岛账号后展示博士等级、助战干员、干员收藏、时装、蚀刻章，以及集成战略 / 剿灭 / 保全派驻等游戏数据。内置干员与时装图鉴（职业 / 稀有度筛选），并提供 4x2 / 4x4 主页小组件。玩家数据以共享快照展示，绑定与刷新由房间管理员维护，其他用户只读。跟随宿主亮暗主题，内置简体中文 / English。

en-US.long_description: Arknights player profile viewer: bind a Skland account to show Doctor level, support operators, operator collection, outfits, medals, and game data such as Integrated Strategies / Annihilation / Stationary Security. Includes operator and outfit indexes with class / rarity filters, plus 4x2 / 4x4 home widgets. Player data is shown as a shared snapshot maintained by the room admin; other users are read-only. Follows the host light/dark theme, with Simplified Chinese and English.
